PdfPreview.title: PDF Preview
PdfPreview.description: Compare three PDF preview implementations: react-pdf, iframe embed, and raw pdf.js
PdfPreview.reactPdfDescription: react-pdf@10: Document + Page components with paging and zoom, toolbar built from shadcn primitives
PdfPreview.embedDescription: iframe embeds the browser's native PDF viewer — zero deps, but iOS Safari renders only page 1
PdfPreview.pdfjsDescription: pdfjs-dist renders directly to canvas: the raw engine with full control

ImagePreview.title: Image Preview
ImagePreview.description: Click a thumbnail to open the lightbox; navigate with the arrow buttons or keyboard
ImagePreview.dialogDescription: Self-built Dialog + img lightbox: click a thumbnail to open the full image, with prev/next, index and keyboard support
ImagePreview.galleryDescription: @7ovr/gallery-1 community block: tag-filtered grid with hover info overlay and Dialog lightbox
ImagePreview.cambioDescription: @delta/cambio-image: click-to-zoom single image with IntersectionObserver lazy reveal and animated popup
ImagePreview.zoomDescription: @kibo-ui/image-zoom: wraps react-medium-image-zoom for smooth in-place zoom
ImagePreview.zoomHint: Click the image to try the zoom

UserManagement.title: User Management
UserManagement.description: Manage platform users, customer project members and account security
UserManagement.refreshHint: Expired tokens renew silently; if renewal fails you are signed out.
UserManagement.refreshHintDetail: Click “Simulate expiry” to demo it live: the session expires and renews instantly, work continues uninterrupted (story #8).
UserManagement.createInternalDescription: Create an internal account (Implementation / Development / After-sales). It can sign in immediately.

UserManagement.errorSelfDisable: You can't disable your own account
UserManagement.inviteDescription: Generate a one-time invite link (valid 7 days, revocable). Copy the link and share it — the system never sends email.
UserManagement.inviteCustomerPlaceholder: Type or pick a customer (new customers can be created)
UserManagement.inviteProjectPlaceholder: Type or pick a project (new projects can be created)
UserManagement.linkHint: The link works once and expires after 7 days.

UserManagement.confirmCreateCustomer: Customer “{name}” does not exist yet. Confirming will create the customer with its default project “{project}” and continue with the invitation.
UserManagement.confirmCreateProject: Project “{name}” does not exist under customer “{customer}”. Confirming will create it and continue with the invitation.
UserManagement.similarCustomersHint: Similar existing customers detected: {names}. Create a new customer anyway?
UserManagement.securityDescription: Pick a user and set a new password: it takes effect immediately and the old one stops working. Relay the new password to the user (decision 2026-08: no self-service reset).
UserManagement.selectUserPlaceholder: Pick the user whose password to reset
UserManagement.toastPasswordReset: Password reset — relay the new password to the user
UserManagement.myViewDescription: Your roles and project access on this platform

UserManagement.permViewAssignedProjects: Access data of projects you are assigned to
